learning_outcomes.text: Modern applications in traditional manufacturing processes (Minimum quantity lubrication (MQL) technology, Cryogenic cooling technology)
chemical and electro chemical nontraditional manufacturing processes

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Course and determination of presentation works for the final evaluation
Classification of manufacturing methods, some modern applications in traditional manufacturing processes (minimum quantity lubrication technology, cryogenic cooling technology)
Cryogenic machining and cryogenic treatment technologies in manufacturing processes, nano-micro-meso-macro manufacturing, introduction to nontraditional manufacturing processes
Classification of nontraditional manufacturing processes, introduction to electrical discharge machining (EDM), EDM research areas, classification of EDM processes, EDM working principle
EDM system components, parameters affecting EDM performance, advantages and disadvantages of EDM method

Electrode wears in EDM processes, Micro EDM method, determination of material removal rate by experimental and theoretical methods in EDM processes, determination of white layer thickness as theoretically
Introduction to electrochemical machining (ECM), ECM process mechanism, ECM process parameters, electrolyte requirements in ECM operations, ECM capabilities and limitations
